marcaServidor: The page's watermark is applied on the server: you don't need to add it.
agendaFacebook: Facebook holds the schedule, so it goes out at that time even if this system is down. To cancel or change it, go to the page's Meta Business Suite.
anticipacion: Facebook requires at least 10 minutes' notice. The time is your computer's.

historiaAparte: A separate post from the feed one. The image is fitted to 9:16 with a blurred background.
notaTexto: The post's text is burned into the bottom strip. If you edit it above, hit Regenerate. Emojis are skipped: the renderer can't draw them in color and they come out as smudges.
